lead: Friday's theme is consolidation - of products, of infrastructure, and of positions. [Microsoft made its Copilot 'super app' official](../summaries/61f8ba08662d.md), folding chat, coding and the rebranded Autopilot agents into one interface, while [Google unveiled Project Suncatcher](../summaries/a1a9cda1ffd3.md) to test AI compute in orbit and [Docker shipped cloud sandboxes](../summaries/f29a87cc1c2f.md) so agents can run around the clock. [DensityAI, the ex-Tesla Dojo chip startup, is in talks to raise hundreds of millions at a $10B valuation](../summaries/b210ac1b4487.md). The diplomatic split hardened: [the US stood alone at the UN dismissing AI safety concerns](../summaries/ccdde235b22f.md) as [Xi Jinping told the White House summit both nations have 'the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good'](../summaries/468aea7c71ac.md), and [experts debated air-gapping](../summaries/d3308afa4bf8.md) after the summer's agent escapes. In the community trenches, [GNOME and KDE are fighting over LLM contribution policies](../summaries/1aebf0bf9a7a.md) - really, one author argues, over the raison d'etre of free software - and [the GPT-6 Astra code-breaking logs keep yielding details](../summaries/a2d471e92c66.md).
